linkedin:
> Inventory every Machine, volume, snapshot, and region in your Fly apps, then export your secrets with `fly secrets list` and your data with `pg_dump`.

Create the equivalent on Kloudbean: one always-on server running your app and workers under PM2, plus a managed database. Copy volume contents deliberately, since volumes are local to a host and never replicated for you. Verify on the temporary URL, cut DNS over in a quiet window, then destroy the Fly volumes and apps, because they keep billing until you do.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/migrate-fly-to-kloudbean/
